## Purpose and Entry Points
MonoGame is a C#/.NET reimplementation of XNA for cross-platform game development. Its primary deliverables are framework assemblies, asset-build tools, editor tooling, templates, native runtimes, and NuGet packages. Build roots are target-specific solutions plus the orchestrated build program: `Build.sln`, `build/Program.cs`, and `build/Build.csproj`.

## Game Runtime Core
The public game model centers on `Game`, components, services, timing, windows, and device management. Applications subclass `Game`; the platform selects a host/window implementation, runs update/draw lifecycle work, and coordinates graphics initialization. Core paths: `MonoGame.Framework/Game.cs`, `MonoGame.Framework/GamePlatform.cs`, `MonoGame.Framework/GraphicsDeviceManager.cs`.

## Graphics Abstraction and Backends
Managed graphics APIs expose devices, resources, effects, textures, buffers, render targets, and `SpriteBatch`. Backend-specific partial implementations bind these APIs to DirectX, OpenGL, web, and native implementations; graphics resources therefore cross a managed-to-platform boundary. Key paths: `MonoGame.Framework/Graphics/GraphicsDevice.cs`, `MonoGame.Framework/Platform/Graphics/GraphicsDevice.OpenGL.cs`, `MonoGame.Framework/Platform/Graphics/GraphicsDevice.DirectX.cs`.

## Platform Integration
Platform hosts implement game windows, lifecycle, input, audio, media, filesystem access, and sensors while preserving common framework APIs. Desktop commonly uses SDL; Android and iOS have dedicated game platform/window layers; Windows also includes WinForms paths. Core paths: `MonoGame.Framework/Platform/SDL/SDLGamePlatform.cs`, `MonoGame.Framework/Platform/Android/AndroidGamePlatform.cs`, `MonoGame.Framework/Platform/iOS/iOSGamePlatform.cs`.

## Native Runtime Boundary
Native C++ libraries provide interop-facing implementations for graphics, assets, media, and audio, including DirectX 12, Vulkan, SDL, FAudio, and XAudio. Managed Native platform files declare the P/Invoke-facing layer; native APIs and structs form a compatibility-critical contract. Core paths: `MonoGame.Framework/Platform/Native/GraphicsDevice.Native.cs`, `native/monogame/include/api_MGG.h`, `native/monogame/vulkan/MGG_Vulkan.cpp`.

## Content Pipeline
Assets flow from importers through processors into serialized runtime content. `PipelineManager` and the preview `ContentBuilder` coordinate discovery, build contexts, dependency/cache behavior, and logging; writers emit compiled content consumed by `ContentManager` and type readers at runtime. Core paths: `MonoGame.Framework.Content.Pipeline/PipelineBuilder/PipelineManager.cs`, `MonoGame.Framework.Content.Pipeline/Serialization/Compiler/ContentCompiler.cs`, `MonoGame.Framework/Content/ContentManager.cs`.

## Tools, Effects, Packaging
`mgcb` is the command-line content builder; the editor is a GUI front end over pipeline project/controller models. `mgfxc` parses/preprocesses effects and emits backend-targeted effect data, feeding runtime `Effect` loading. The build project compiles framework/tool variants, shaders, native dependencies, templates, tests, and deployment packages; NuGet projects package framework and preview runtime variants. Core paths: `Tools/MonoGame.Content.Builder/Program.cs`, `Tools/MonoGame.Effect.Compiler/Program.cs`, `src/NuGetPackages/MonoGame.Framework/MonoGame.Framework.csproj`.
